description: This file defines a report parser class for generating crossovered budget reports in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including methods for computing budget data and totals.

classes.name: budget_report
classes.description: A report parser class for crossovered budget reports, providing methods to compute budget details and totals.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser, setting up local context with functions and time.

methods.name: funct
methods.description: Computes detailed budget data for a given object and form parameters, returning a list of budget line dictionaries.

methods.name: funct_total
methods.description: Returns total budget figures accumulated during report generation.
